bias.en: Rebound · SAR bullish, slipped back under $54
bias.zh: 反弹 · 抛物线 SAR 看多，回落至 $54 下方

read.en: AAOI fell 5.4% on Nov 12 to $52.85, trading $50.80–55.65 on light volume (0.69x the 20-day average). It is above the 5-day ($51.85) and below the 10-day ($56.09), 30-day ($79.62), 100-day ($103.98) and 200-day ($114.93); only the 200-day is rising. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 11 ($45.41), and RSI is 35.9.
read.zh: AAOI 11月12日下跌 5.4%，收于 $52.85，盘中区间 $50.80–55.65，成交量偏低（20 日均量的 0.69 倍）。股价位于 5 日均线（$51.85）上方，10 日（$56.09）、30 日（$79.62）、100 日（$103.98）和 200 日均线（$114.93）下方；仅 200 日均线在上行。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月11日起看多（$45.41），RSI 为 35.9。

read.en: The close gave back the $54.03 Nov 9 high, now resistance, while the $50.80 low held the $50.8–52.1 zone. Resistance is $54–55.7 (Nov 9 high, Nov 12 high), then $56.1–57.9 (10-day, Nov 11 high) and $62.5–64.1. Support is $50.8–52.1 (Nov 12 low, 5-day, Nov 9 close), then $45.2–46.4 (SAR, Nov 6 and Nov 10 lows). A close above $56.1 would target $58–62.5; below $50.8, $45.4–46.4.

s.en: Parabolic SAR $45.41; Nov 6 low $45.15; Nov 10 low $46.39
